title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Apply themselves to a profession as engineers who have ningenryoku (in Japanese) and strength as innovators who can think and act for themselves.
(2) Set goals for going on to graduate school or finding a job as a plan for their career.
advice:
We will cover the following topics based on the student's self-analysis and career planning:

1. Self-analysis: Past and present, advantages and disadvantages
2. Practice exam: Synthetic Personality Inventory (SPI)

Students are required to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to check for various messages and materials in class.
requiredKnowledge: Career Planning Seminar I is a required course aimed at helping students going on to graduate school or finding jobs. Therefore, all students are resquired to attend regardless of own study continuation plans.

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider the relationship between career planning and life design
Be able to identify advantages and disadvantages in career development
Be able to assess your own knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification, as needed to determine a career plan
Be able to present your own career planning policies and goals

achievementLevels.ideal:
Be able to do the following things based on your own understanding from the various career planning activities:
(1) Sufficiently consider the relationship between career planning and life design
(2) Fully analyze your advantages and disadvantages for development of your career
(3) Investigate the knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification needed to determine your career plan
(4) Present your own career planning policies and goals in detail
achievementLevels.standard:
Be able to do the following things based on your own understanding from the various career planning activities:
(1) Consider the relationship between career planning and life design
(2) Analyze your advantages and disadvantages for development of your career
(3) Investigate the knowledge, ability, skill, and qualification needed to determine your career plan
(4) Present your own career planning policies and goals
